verdict.rationale: Mollie's docs show an extensive, API-first surface (Payments, Refunds, Chargebacks, Settlements, Balances, Subscriptions, Connect/Split payments, Webhooks incl. new subscription/audit model, multi-currency, idempotency, scoped auth tokens) that mirrors nearly everything manageable in the dashboard, and even documents an MCP server exposing many of these APIs to AI agents. The one caveat noted in docs itself is that refunds 'can also' be created manually via the Web app, implying UI and API are largely interchangeable rather than UI having exclusive capability. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that every dashboard-only action (e.g., account settings, merchant onboarding UI flows) has a full API equivalent, and independent/hands-on verification beyond vendor documentation.
